articles.summary: I have interviewed Jumia Technologies (JMIA) CEO Francis Dufay for over three years. I have followed the company even longer. The experience has been a roller coaster requiring focus on the company’s long-term potential while carefully managing short-term risk. Dufay made thatfocus easier with a successful turnaround strategy and a plan that created a resilient enterprise built for growth. Yet, this latest swoosh down the elevator of a tough operating environment is the deepest test yet of my bullish thesis. Perhaps only the “primal panic” two years ago in the aftermath of a stock offering rivals the market’s latest crisis of confidence in the company and the stock.
articles.title: Jumia Technologies Q3: Untimely Resurgence Of Macroeconomic Pressures (Seeking Alpha)
